transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess the main thing is I barely want to eat anymore. Like, at work on my lunch break, I’ll get food I used to actually like, and then I just sit there looking at it and end up throwing most of it away. That’s what made me think I should probably come in.
Have you been feeling down or depressed?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I don’t feel great, but I don’t know if I’d call it depressed exactly. It’s just been… off, I guess.
Have you been feeling sad most days?
I don’t know. I haven’t really been thinking of it as sad most days. It’s more like I just feel kind of blank or off.
Are you avoiding food because you’re worried about gaining weight?

No, it’s not about gaining weight. I just don’t really want to eat. I’ll be on my lunch break at the store with food I used to like, and I just kind of stare at it and end up throwing most of it away.
Have you also lost interest or enjoyment in things you usually like doing?

Yeah… I think so. Stuff I used to look forward to, like gallery nights, playing basketball, getting tacos from the food trucks, or helping kids with art things… lately I just kind of stand there and feel flat. Most of the time I make some excuse to leave.
Have you been feeling down most of the day?
I’m not really sure. I wouldn’t say I feel down all day, exactly. It’s more like I’m just kind of off or empty a lot of the time.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About two months, I guess. It kind of started after that window display award thing, when the district manager started paying attention to me. Since then I’ve just felt… like this.
During the past two months, have you felt sad or hopeless?
I don’t know if I’d call it sad, exactly. Hopeless… maybe sometimes, but it’s more like I just don’t feel much, or I feel stuck. It’s hard to explain.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?
Yeah. Most nights I just lie there thinking over that award thing and stuff people said at the store. If I do fall asleep, I wake up really early and then I can’t get my mind to stop.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot?
I’m not sure. I mean, I think about things a lot, but I don’t know if I’d call it worrying exactly. It’s just kind of always there in my head.
Do you feel anxious or on edge a lot of the time?
I don’t really know. I don’t think I’m on edge all the time, exactly. I just get stuck thinking about things, and it’s hard to shut off.
Have you been feeling hopeless a lot lately?
I don’t know. I mean, I’ve been feeling pretty down, but “hopeless”... I’m not sure. I haven’t really thought about it that way.
Lately, have you been feeling worthless?

Yeah… I guess so. I keep thinking I didn’t really deserve that award, or the chance at supervisor. Like maybe I somehow fooled everyone into thinking I’m better than I am. People tell me I didn’t trick anybody, but I still feel guilty about it.
Before this started two months ago, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt this same kind of loss of interest and emptiness for weeks at a time?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve had it like this before for weeks, at least not that I can remember.
Over the past two months, have you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I don’t know if I’d say most of the day nearly every day. I’ve been feeling pretty down a lot, but I haven’t really kept track like that.
Have you actually been feeling less hungry than usual?

Yeah. That’s actually part of why I came in. I barely want to eat anymore. I’ll be on my lunch break at the store with food I used to like, and I just kind of stare at it… then end up throwing most of it away.
Have you lost weight since this started?
I think so, yeah. I haven’t been eating much at all. Like at work, I’ll have lunch in front of me and just stare at it, even stuff I used to like, and then I end up throwing most of it away.
Have you been having thoughts that you’d be better off dead or of hurting yourself?
I’m… not really sure how to answer that. I don’t think I’ve been planning to hurt myself or anything like that. I just feel really low sometimes.
Have you had thoughts that you would be better off dead?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say I’ve been thinking that exactly. I’ve just been feeling really down, but I’m not sure I’d put it like being better off dead.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about a lot of different things?
Not really a lot of different things, no. I mean, I worry about stuff sometimes, but I haven’t noticed it being like constant worrying about everything.

final_diagnosis.reason: The presentation is most consistent with a depressive episode, unspecified: about 2 months of markedly reduced appetite with weight loss, clear loss of interest/pleasure, insomnia with early morning awakening, low/empty mood, and feelings of worthlessness/guilt. Anxiety symptoms were probed but excessive generalized worry or persistent on-edge anxiety were not confirmed. Eating-disorder motivation was denied, making primary eating disorder diagnoses less likely; anorexia alone does not account for the broader depressive syndrome.
